full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman J: Plaintiff-Respondents filed a suit for perpetual injunction in the Court of Assistant Judge, Faridpur, being Title Suit No. 21 of 1993, and prayed for temporary injunction in that suit. Ad interim injunction was granted and subsequently on hearing the parties the ad interim order was vacated and the prayer for temporary injunction was rejected. Against that order plaintiffs filed Miscellaneous Appeal No. 24 of 1993 and the District Judge, Faridpur affirmed the order of rejection of temporary injunction and disallowed the appeal. Against that order plaintiffs preferred Civil Revision No. 2093 of 1993 and the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division made the Rule absolute with a direction to dispose of the suit expeditiously within a period of three months. Defendant-petitioners are now seeking leave to appeal from the impugned judgment of the High Court Division. 

 2. Plaintiffs filed the suit in a representative capacity and prayed for perpetual injunction restraining the defendants from installing or running any Rice, Dal and Wheat Mill in holding No. 40/1, Chawkbazar within Faridpur Municipal Area, on the allegations that the said holding is within the residential area and establishment of such a Mill will adversely effect the health conditions of the residents of the locality. 

 5. It appears that the learned Single Judge found that the plaintiffs have a prima facie case for temporary injunction as from the report of the Sanitary Inspector it appears that the dust and sound from the said Mill will cause health hazards to the residents of the area. In that view of the matter, the judgment and order of the appellate Court was set aside and injunction was granted in favour of the plaintiff with a direction to dispose of the suit within three months. 

 7. Since the learned Single Judge has found a prima facie case and granted injunction and directed to dispose of the case within 3 months, we are reluctant to interfere with the interlocutory order of the High Court Division.
